after_diagnostics.method: macOS allocator zone totals; live heap and reserved allocator bytes, not RSS

after_load.method: macOS allocator zone totals; live heap and reserved allocator bytes, not RSS

after_setup.method: macOS allocator zone totals; live heap and reserved allocator bytes, not RSS

backend_io_method: stock FileBackend request counts and requested bytes; includes OS-cache hits and failed requests, not physical disk I/O; per-case totals cover timed iterations only, excluding warmup and preparation

file_footprint.allocated_bytes_source: filesystem st_blocks multiplied by 512; excludes directory metadata
file_footprint.measurement: after timed queries, while database and snapshot remain open
file_footprint.scope: main database and explicitly known sidecars only

paged_diagnostics.commit_method: completed engine durable groups since open, including fixture setup; not filesystem synchronization call counts or a concurrent TPS measurement
paged_diagnostics.counter_scope: logical instrumented operations, not physical I/O or redb page-cache misses
paged_diagnostics.read_method: one untimed instrumented reader execution per case after all timed queries; preparation excluded; cache state follows the timed suite
paged_diagnostics.storage_method: host-admin pinned table accounting collected after all queries; excludes file headers, allocators, free and historical pages

peak_rss_phases.method: process lifetime high-water RSS sampled at untimed phase boundaries, not current memory or phase allocation
